_doc: Beam extents measured on the rebar plans (K-12, K-22, K-32, K-42) where the automatic band detection of tools/extract_rebar.py is not enough (bands that run on into a collinear beam, beams drawn dashed under walls, skewed beams, beams with no number). Coordinates are pt of the REBAR sheet (x right, y down). 'lat' = the band centre line (y for a horizontal beam, x for a vertical one), 'along' = start/end along the band. 'a'/'b' = explicit end points (skewed beam). Every entry carries its evidence. Read only by tools/extract_rebar.py.
